attributes.action: Call for an Immediate General Election
attributes.additional_details: Andy Burnham has assumed his position without a competitive election or any formal vote from Labour MPs. No challengers emerged, and he received no endorsement through a ballot of his parliamentary colleagues. This process raises legitimate questions about democratic accountability. To uphold the principles of representative democracy, Parliament should be dissolved, allowing the public to express its will at the ballot box.
attributes.background: Andy Burnham assumed office without any competitive election or vote from Labour MPs. With no challengers, this lacks proper democratic accountability. Parliament should be dissolved so the public can vote, upholding their democratic rights.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
